title: เช็คราคาทองวันนี้ 4 กันยายน 2569 ล่าสุด ราคาปรับเพิ่ม 650 บาท ราคาทองรูปพรรณ บาทละ 70,600 บาท

title_cn: 今日金价上扬 黄金饰品每克报价 70,600 泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国黄金价格 9 月 4 日更新，较前日上涨 650 泰铢。其中黄金饰品(ทองรูปพรรณ)每克报价 70,600 泰铢，金条(ทองคำแท่ง)每克 69,800 泰铢，黄金 1 钱报价 17,450 泰铢，根据泰国黄金商协会最新公告。

title: รัฐบาลเร่งดัน SME ใช้สิทธิ FTA ลดต้นทุนภาษี ครึ่งปีแรกใช้สิทธิแล้ว 1.57 ล้านล้าน โต 7.33%
desc: รัฐบาลเร่งดัน SME ใช้สิทธิจากความตกลงการค้าเสรี (FTA) ลดต้นทุนทางภาษี เพิ่มแต้มต่อส่งออก หลังครึ่งปีแรกใช้สิทธิแล้ว 1.57 ล้านล้านบาท โต 7.33%
title_cn: 泰国政府推动中小企业利用 FTA 权益降低税收成本
summary_cn: 泰国政府积极推动中小企业(SME)利用自由贸易协定(FTA)权益降低商品出口的税收负担。今年上半年中小企业已利用 FTA 权益金额达 1.57 万亿泰铢，同比增长 7.33%，有助于增强企业国际竞争力。

title: ปั๊มบางจาก บลูมมิ่ง เทลส์ พุทธมณฑลสาย 3 ซิวรางวัลห้องน้ำสะอาดแห่งปี กทม.2569 ต่อเนื่อง 2 ปีซ้อน
desc: สถานีบริการน้ำมันบางจาก บลูมมิ่งเทลส์ @พุทธมณฑลสาย 3 ได้รับรางวัล สุดยอดห้องน้ำแห่งปีของกรุงเทพมหานคร ประจำปี 2569 กลุ่มสถานีบริการเชื้อเพลิง จากกรุงเทพมหานคร เป็นปีที่ 2 ติดต่อกัน
title_cn: 曼谷邦查克加油站连获佳绩 连续两年获评年度最佳卫生间
summary_cn: 位于曼谷佛统湾(Phutthamonthon)路 3 号线的邦查克(Bangchak) Blooming Tales 加油站再次获得曼谷 2026 年度最佳卫生间奖。这是该加油站在加油站类别中连续第二年获此殊荣，彰显了其对公共设施卫生维护的持续重视。

summary_cn: 泰国达府(Trat)村级五戒推广委员会在象岛(Koh Chang)开展宣传活动。府尹强调遵守五戒(Sila)规范对建设和谐社会的重要作用，有利于民众身心健康、心态安宁，营造正常祥和的社会环境。

title: Court ruling fails to settle NBTC chair dispute
desc: A former commissioner of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has urged any party affected by the dispute over the chairman's qualification to ask the Central Administrative Court to make a definitive ruling on the chairman's legal status.
title_cn: 法院裁决无法平息泰国广播电视通信委员会主席纠纷
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电视通信委员会（NBTC, National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission）前任委员呼吁相关各方向行政法院提起诉讼，争取对现任主席法律身份的明确裁定，以彻底解决权限争议。
desc_original: A former commissioner of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has urged any party affected by the dispute over the chairman's qualification to ask the Central Administrative Court to make a definitive ruling on the chairman's legal status.

title_cn: 雀巢追加64亿泰铢投资 扩建罗勇宠物食品产业基地
summary_cn: 全球食品集团雀巢（Nestlé）继续扩大在泰国的投资，在罗勇府（Rayong）Amata City工业园追加投资64.3亿泰铢，用于扩建宠物食品生产基地，进一步彰显泰国作为全球第二大宠物食品出口国的产业优势。

title: Central Group appoints Wallaya Chirathivat president
desc: Central Group has announced the appointment of Wallaya Chirathivat as president, strengthening its senior leadership team and positioning the organisation for future growth.
title_cn: Central Group 宣布任命 Wallaya Chirathivat 为总裁
summary_cn: Central Group 宣布任命 Wallaya Chirathivat 为总裁，进一步加强公司高层管理团队。Wallaya Chirathivat 系零售业知名的 Chirathivat 家族成员，该任命标志着这家泰国主要零售商业集团的重要人事变动，将影响集团的战略方向和长期发展规划。
desc_original: Central Group has announced the appointment of Wallaya Chirathivat as president, strengthening its senior leadership team and positioning the organisation for future growth.

title: ดันพิมพ์เขียวสกัดโกงออนไลน์ รัฐ-เอกชนโหมโรงจัดประชุมIMF-World Bank
desc: ภาครัฐ-เอกชนจัด The Bangkok Business Summit 2026 โหมโรงก่อนประชุม IMF-World Bank นายกฯ ประกาศความพร้อมไทยสู่สปริงบอร์ดเชื่อมอาเซียน ธปท.เปิด "Bangkok Blueprint"ต้นแบบสกัดภัยไซเบอร์ระดับโลก
title_cn: 泰国力推网络安全防护，Bangkok Business Summit 2026 为 IMF-World Bank 年会预热
summary_cn: 泰国政府与私人部门联合举办 The Bangkok Business Summit 2026，为即将召开的国际货币基金组织与世界银行年会做准备。总理宣布泰国作为连接东盟 ASEAN 区域的枢纽准备就绪，泰央行推出「Bangkok Blueprint」作为全球网络安全防范的标杆方案，旨在打击网络欺诈和数据威胁。
desc_original: ภาครัฐ-เอกชนจัด The Bangkok Business Summit 2026 โหมโรงก่อนประชุม IMF-World Bank นายกฯ ประกาศความพร้อมไทยสู่สปริงบอร์ดเชื่อมอาเซียน ธปท.เปิด "Bangkok Blueprint"ต้นแบบสกัดภัยไซเบอร์ระดับโลก

title: 'Fake father' scheme poses security risk, panel warns
desc: The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.
title_cn: 「假父亲」骗局构成国家安全隐患，议会敦促严查
summary_cn: 泰国众议院公共卫生委员会敦促当局加大对「假父亲」诈骗网络的调查力度。该骗局涉及外国人通过欺诈手段非法注册成泰国籍，最终可能获得购买房产和参与政治活动的权利，构成严重国家安全风险。此类身份造假问题直接威胁泰国的法律制度和外籍人口管理秩序。
desc_original: The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.

title: Parliament  rejects air bill changes
desc: The House of Representatives has rejected Senate amendments to the Clean Air Management Bill, voting instead to set up a joint committee to reconsider changes that MPs say would weaken pollution controls.
title_cn: 泰国众议院驳回《清洁空气管理法案》修正案
summary_cn: 泰国众议院否决了参议院对《清洁空气管理法案》的修改提议，决定成立联合委员会重新审议。众议院议员表示参议院修正案将削弱污染防控效力。该法案的最终版本将直接影响曼谷及全国的空气质量标准，进而关系到所有居民的公共卫生和日常生活质量。
desc_original: The House of Representatives has rejected Senate amendments to the Clean Air Management Bill, voting instead to set up a joint committee to reconsider changes that MPs say would weaken pollution controls.

title: Call-centre scams cost retirees billions
desc: Cyber police have warned retirees and older people about call-centre scams after losses among victims aged 60 and above reached 3.15 billion baht in eight months.
title_cn: 电话诈骗猖獗，泰国老年人八个月损失逾31.5亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国网络警察部门发出警告，针对老年人和退休人员的呼叫中心诈骗案件激增。过去八个月内，年龄在60岁以上的受害者累计损失达31.5亿泰铢 Thai Baht。诈骗集团常以虚假投资、亲属急难、税务问题等借口行骗，对包括外国退休人士在内的群体构成严重财产威胁。
desc_original: Cyber police have warned retirees and older people about call-centre scams after losses among victims aged 60 and above reached 3.15 billion baht in eight months.

title: Parit queried on sources of leaked report
desc: People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.
title_cn: 人民党议员帕里特被质询泄露报告信息来源
summary_cn: 人民党议员帕里特（Parit Wacharasindhu）周四被众议院警务委员会质询，内容涉及其在参议院选举串通指控中所引用的信息来源。此事反映了泰国政治中对选举过程透明度和权力制衡的持续关注。
desc_original: People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.

title: Nectec steps up push for tech sovereignty
desc: The National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (Nectec) has estimated its research generates an economic impact of more than 10 billion baht annually as the agency shifts its focus towards technological sovereignty and steps up investment in quantum technology, physical artificial intelligence (AI) and space communications.
title_cn: 泰国国家电子计算机技术中心推进科技自主战略
summary_cn: 泰国国家电子计算机技术中心（Nectec）宣布其研究每年产生超 100 亿泰铢的经济效益，并加大对量子技术、物理人工智能和空间通信的投资，将重点转向科技自主和战略自给，标志着泰国在科技领域的长期战略布局。
desc_original: The National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (Nectec) has estimated its research generates an economic impact of more than 10 billion baht annually as the agency shifts its focus towards technological sovereignty and steps up investment in quantum technology, physical artificial intelligence (AI) and space communications.

title: Phuket records a foreign arrival rebound in July
desc: Phuket's foreign arrivals are rebounding as the impact of the Middle East conflict subsides, but the hospitality sector still faces challenges from tighter consumer spending and intensifying competition.
title_cn: 普吉岛七月外国游客到访数反弹
summary_cn: 随着中东冲突影响逐渐消退，普吉岛外国游客到访数出现反弹。但酒店业仍面临消费支出收紧和竞争加剧的压力。这反映了泰国作为旅游目的地的吸引力恢复情况。
desc_original: Phuket's foreign arrivals are rebounding as the impact of the Middle East conflict subsides, but the hospitality sector still faces challenges from tighter consumer spending and intensifying competition.

title: Court talks address online crime
desc: The Criminal Court has brought together police, banks, the media and the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) to discuss ways to tackle online crime, which the court says now accounts for over half of its cases.
title_cn: 法院会议聚焦网络犯罪治理
summary_cn: 泰国刑事法院联合警察、银行、媒体和反洗钱办公室（Amlo）召开会议，讨论应对网络犯罪的措施。网络犯罪现已占该法院案件的一半以上，对在泰外国人的信息安全和资金安全具有重要威胁。
desc_original: The Criminal Court has brought together police, banks, the media and the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) to discuss ways to tackle online crime, which the court says now accounts for over half of its cases.

title: Data centres advise balance in regulations
desc: Amid tighter scrutiny of data centres over fuel safety, zoning and environmental concerns, Thailand should close regulatory gaps without an overcorrection that could undermine investment, capitalising on the industry's expansion to build a higher-value domestic artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain, according to the Thailand Data Center Association (TDCA).
title_cn: 数据中心业界呼吁监管平衡
summary_cn: 在燃料安全、分区和环保审查加强的背景下，泰国数据中心协会（TDCA）表示应补全监管漏洞但避免过度管制打击投资。业界建议利用产业扩张机遇建立高价值的本地人工智能产业链，对泰国长期经济发展战略意义重大。
desc_original: Amid tighter scrutiny of data centres over fuel safety, zoning and environmental concerns, Thailand should close regulatory gaps without an overcorrection that could undermine investment, capitalising on the industry's expansion to build a higher-value domestic artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain, according to the Thailand Data Center Association (TDCA).

desc: Maid’s 100-million-baht windfall exposes illegal firms Legacy Police in Surat Thani have concluded their investigation into two nominee companies linked to a French businesswoman who died by suicide on Koh Samui in 2024, recommending prosecution over illegal landholding through Thai nominees. The case, which drew national attention after the woman left a fortune worth nearly 100 million baht to her housekeeper, has now moved to the Koh Samui prosecutor’s office. Investigating Officer Police Lieutenant Colonel Kittisak Charoenroop of Surat Thani City Police submitted the finalised case file for signature by Police Major General Suwat Suksri, commander of the Surat Thani Provincial Police. The file recommends prosecuting G.V.N.E. Co., Ltd. and Maxicate Co., Ltd. for operating as foreign nominee companies engaged in land trading, in breach of the Foreign Business Act. Investigators also recommended charges against two Thai nationals accused of supporting the illegal arrangement. title: LISA releases ‘SaWaDiKa’ as new single puts Thai identity on the global stage
desc: LISA releases ‘SaWaDiKa’ as new single puts Thai identity on the global stage Legacy The Thai superstar opens her PRESS PLAY era with a song named after Thailand’s best-known greeting, backed by visuals featuring Muay Thai, tuk-tuks and Bangkok. The song premiered at 7am Thailand time through LLOUD Official. It serves as the first single from LISA’s upcoming six-track EP PRESS PLAY, which is scheduled for release on October 23. Promotional images and videos have featured Muay Thai-inspired styling and a blue-and-red tuk-tuk. The two elements are instantly recognisable as Thai, and they arrive here through a contemporary pop and fashion aesthetic. title: Australia eyes drug production potential
desc: Australia is exploring Thailand as a potential manufacturing base and regional hub for complementary medicines, as Australian businesses seek to expand investment and long-term cooperation.
title_cn: 澳大利亚看好泰国药物生产潜力
summary_cn: 澳大利亚正在探索泰国作为互补医药（保健品补充剂）生产制造基地和地区贸易枢纽的潜力。澳大利亚企业部门寻求在泰国扩大投资规模并建立长期合作关系。此举反映出泰国作为东南亚医药制造中心的战略价值不断提升，同时表明该产业对国际资本的吸引力持续增强，有助于推动泰国制造业转型升级。
desc_original: Australia is exploring Thailand as a potential manufacturing base and regional hub for complementary medicines, as Australian businesses seek to expand investment and long-term cooperation.

title: BMA stepping  up checks on  Chabad houses
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.
title_cn: 曼谷都市局加强ChaBaD中心监管检查
summary_cn: 曼谷都市局（BMA）正在加强对ChaBaD中心设施的检查。此举针对这些设施在以色列游客和外国居民集中区域的扩张。ChaBaD是正统犹太教国际组织，在曼谷外籍社群中有较多分布。当局的监管举措可能涉及安全、卫生、许可证或房屋用途等常规检查，反映出曼谷对外籍人士聚集区的日常管理动态。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.

title: Doctor faces probe over 'low class' jibe
desc: A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.
title_cn: 医生因侮辱医保患者遭卫生部调查
summary_cn: 曼谷一名医生因威胁肾脏病患者、公开贬低30泰铢全民医保受益人为「低等阶级」而接受泰国公共卫生部调查。该事件涉及医德操守与社会阶层歧视问题，引发公众关注。30泰铢医保计划是泰国政府面向低收入群体的重要社保项目，医疗工作者的不当言行可能引发更广泛的社会讨论与行业整顿。
desc_original: A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.

title: Sondhi planning street mobilisation
desc: Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.
title_cn: 抗议领袖宋迪·林通库尔 Sondhi Limthongkul 筹划街头动员活动
summary_cn: 资深政治活动人士宋迪·林通库尔正筹划大规模街头动员活动，引发泰国政治局势进一步升温。总理阿努廷·查尔维拉库尔 Anutin Charnvirakul 随即发出严厉警告，强调任何形式的示威活动必须严格遵守法律。这反映出泰国政坛长期存在的政治分歧和社会分裂。
desc_original: Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.

title: State firms attempt to retain older talent
desc: The Finance Ministry has proposed amending the law to raise the age limits for chief executives and board members of state-owned enterprises, addressing the challenges of an ageing society.
title_cn: 泰国国企修法提高管理层年龄限制
summary_cn: 为应对人口老龄化导致的人才流失，泰国财政部提议修改法律，提高国有企业首席执行官和董事会成员的强制退休年龄限制。这一改革旨在留住具有丰富经验的资深管理人才，确保国企的长期稳定运营和战略连贯性，是泰国适应老龄化社会的重要举措。
desc_original: The Finance Ministry has proposed amending the law to raise the age limits for chief executives and board members of state-owned enterprises, addressing the challenges of an ageing society.

title: ถี่ยิบ เสาไฟโซลาร์เซลล์ 9.9 ล้าน นายกเทศมนตรี ชี้เหมาะสม คุ้มค่า เกิดประโยชน์ต่อชุมชน
desc: เสาไฟโซลาร์เซลล์ งบ 9.9 ล้านบาท โซเชียลตั้งข้อสงสัย “มันถี่เกินไปไหม” นายกเทศมนตรีตำบลนิคมคำสร้อย ชี้แจงแล้ว ระบุเหมาะสม คุ้มค่า เกิดประโยชน์ต่อชุมชน
title_cn: 尼科姆坎萨罗依镇太阳能路灯项目引发热议
summary_cn: 尼科姆坎萨罗依镇 Nikom Khamsakroy 耗资990万泰铢的太阳能路灯项目在社交媒体引发民众质疑，有人批评路灯布设密度过高。镇长随后出面澄清，辩称该项目规划科学、成本合理，能为当地居民提供可靠电力和夜间安全保障，符合可持续发展方向。
desc_original: เสาไฟโซลาร์เซลล์ งบ 9.9 ล้านบาท โซเชียลตั้งข้อสงสัย “มันถี่เกินไปไหม” นายกเทศมนตรีตำบลนิคมคำสร้อย ชี้แจงแล้ว ระบุเหมาะสม คุ้มค่า เกิดประโยชน์ต่อชุมชน

title: World Bank calls for broader AI adoption in Thailand
desc: Thailand is well-positioned to harness artificial intelligence (AI) to not only lift productivity, but also develop new industries and create more high-skilled jobs, though the challenge remains how to ensure AI is available to all companies, says the World Bank.
title_cn: 世界银行敦促泰国加快人工智能应用
summary_cn: 世界银行发布报告指出泰国具备利用人工智能提升生产力、催生新兴产业、创造高技能就业的良好条件。但报告也指出，当前泰国面临的关键挑战是如何确保中小企业和偏远地区也能平等获得人工智能技术支持，实现包容性的经济转型和高质量发展。
desc_original: Thailand is well-positioned to harness artificial intelligence (AI) to not only lift productivity, but also develop new industries and create more high-skilled jobs, though the challenge remains how to ensure AI is available to all companies, says the World Bank.

title: Thailand's finance minister pushes regional economic integration
desc: Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has outlined a vision to position Thailand and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) as a network of “trusted connectors” capable of navigating an increasingly fragmented global economy.
title_cn: 泰国财长推动东盟地区经济一体化
summary_cn: 副总理兼财政部长埃克尼迪·尼地坦普拉帕斯 Ekniti Nitithanprapas 提出宏大愿景，主张将泰国和东盟打造成「可信赖的经济连接者」网络。面对全球经济格局分化加剧，泰国拟发挥地区经济枢纽作用，通过强化跨国商贸投资合作，推动东盟在国际经济体系中的影响力。
desc_original: Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has outlined a vision to position Thailand and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) as a network of “trusted connectors” capable of navigating an increasingly fragmented global economy.

title: Leaders promote resilience as competitive advantage
desc: Thailand must turn global disruptions such as geopolitical tensions, artificial intelligence (AI) and slowing growth into long-term economic opportunities through coordinated investment, according to business leaders at Bangkok Business Summit 2026.
title_cn: 商界领袖倡导韧性成为竞争优势
summary_cn: 曼谷商业峰会2026的商界领袖认为，泰国应将地缘政治紧张局势、人工智能（AI）和经济增长放缓等全球性挑战转化为长期经济机会，通过协调投资予以解决。
desc_original: Thailand must turn global disruptions such as geopolitical tensions, artificial intelligence (AI) and slowing growth into long-term economic opportunities through coordinated investment, according to business leaders at Bangkok Business Summit 2026.

title: Thai lawmaker gets messages of support from Myanmar citizens after protest
desc: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.
title_cn: 泰国议员因抗议缅甸军政权获缅甸民众声援
summary_cn: 一位泰国反对党议员因上月打断泰国对缅甸军人出身总统敏昂莱（Min Aung Hlaing）的官方欢迎仪式而引发关注。他表示收到许多缅甸民众支持信息，声称其行动旨在抗议缅甸的军事独裁统治。
desc_original: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.

title_cn: 泰国经济何去何从？总理、财政部、央行在商业峰会论经济前景
summary_cn: 曼谷商业峰会2026汇聚了对泰国经济具有影响力的领导人物，包括总理阿努廷·占维路（Annutin Charnvirakul）、财政部、泰国央行（BOT）和竞争委员会等，就泰国经济发展方向提出战略观点。

title: ถอดรหัสรายงานธนาคารโลก Building Thailand’s Future Today ปฏิรูปโครงสร้างเศรษฐกิจ
desc: รายงานธนาคารโลกฉบับใหม่ ‘Building Thailand’s Future Today’ เป้าหมายดันไทยสู่ประเทศรายได้สูงในปี 2037 เร่ง GDP โต 5.4% ผ่านการปฏิรูปโครงสร้างเศรษฐกิจ 4 เสาหลักสำคัญ และ 5 อุตสาหกรรมแห่งอนาคต
title_cn: 世界银行新报告：通过结构改革推进泰国未来建设
summary_cn: 世界银行最新报告「今日建设泰国未来」（Building Thailand's Future Today）提出2037年晋升高收入国家目标，需通过经济结构改革实现GDP年增速5.4%，涉及4大经济支柱和5个前瞻性产业发展。

title: US sailors on leave begin exploring Pattaya
desc: PATTAYA - Hordes of US sailors were up early on Thursday as they set out to explore this tourist city on their second day of shore leave.
title_cn: 美国海军水手开始游览芭提雅
summary_cn: 大批美国海军休假水手周四一早启程探索芭提雅旅游城市，这是他们执行访泰任务期间上岸休假的第二天。
desc_original: PATTAYA - Hordes of US sailors were up early on Thursday as they set out to explore this tourist city on their second day of shore leave.

title: Kamphaeng Phet school shooter faces charges
desc: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges, while the school has been closed for two days to review and improve safety measures.
title_cn: 甲米林府（Kamphaeng Phet）校园枪击案：少年枪手面临多项指控
summary_cn: 甲米林府一所学校发生枪击事件，涉事少年学生已被指控多项罪名。学校已关闭两天进行安全评估和改善措施，以防止类似事件再发。
desc_original: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges, while the school has been closed for two days to review and improve safety measures.

title: เมื่อโลกไม่กลับไปเหมือนเดิม ประเทศไทยต้องลงทุนอะไร? เพื่อให้ภาคธุรกิจเติบโตได้ท่ามกลางความผันผวน
desc: เปิดมุมมอง 4 ผู้นำธุรกิจใหญ่ CP-KBank-B.Grimm-Indorama Ventures ชี้ทางออกเศรษฐกิจไทย ต้องเร่งลงทุน “คน-เทคโนโลยี-โครงสร้างพื้นฐาน-ระบบการเงิน” พลิกความผันผวนเป็นโอกาส เชื่อมไทยสู่ตลาดโลก

title: Bangkok’s new electric bus fleet nears production
desc: Bangkok’s new electric bus fleet nears production Legacy The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) is preparing to roll out 1,520 electric buses under a seven-year, 14.9 billion baht lease agreement with Nakhonchai Air Co, Ltd, with the first deliveries expected by the end of March 2027 . BMTA Director Kittikan Chomdoung Charuworapolkul visited the production line of Absolute Assembly Company Limited (AAB) in Chachoengsao province yesterday, September 2, to inspect progress on the buses, which are being manufactured and assembled by NEX Point Public Company Limited on Nakhonchai Air’s behalf. Kittikan said the transition would raise standards of passenger convenience, safety and environmental performance, while helping resolve the BMTA’s long-standing debt problems . He said the organisation expects to cut its operating costs by around 4.1 billion baht a year once the new fleet and supporting systems are fully in place. Core components for the first 40 buses have already reached the assembly plant, which has a maximum production capacity of 15 buses a day, although the BMTA has set a minimum target of 12 a day. title: Sea turtle found stranded and weak on Phuket’s Patong Beach
desc: Sea turtle found stranded and weak on Phuket’s Patong Beach Legacy A sea turtle weighing more than 50 kilogrammes was found stranded on Patong Beach in Phuket today, September 3. The animal was weak and exhausted. It lay on the shore in Patong subdistrict, in Kathu district. Jiraporn Wijit was walking along Patong Beach at around 6am and spotted the turtle on the sand, Khaosod English reported. She then alerted lifeguards stationed at the beach. The lifeguards moved the turtle away from the shoreline. They gave the animal first aid. They also kept its condition under watch while help was arranged. The lifeguards contacted the Siritharn Rare Marine Animal Rescue Centre to take over the animal’s care. The centre is based at the Upper Andaman Marine and Coastal Resources Research Centre in Laem Phanwa, Wichit subdistrict, Muang Phuket district. According to The Phuket News and Thai Rath, the turtle was due to be handed over to the Sireetarn team for a health examination and any necessary treatment, though the two outlets differed on whether this had already happened by the time of publication. The plan is for the centre to care for the turtle until it has recovered enough

title: 1 in 5 children face child sexual abuse online: UNICEF
desc: 1 in 5 children face child sexual abuse online: UNICEF Legacy One in five internet-using children across 21 countries, including Thailand, has experienced online sexual exploitation or abuse in a single year, according to a new UNICEF report described as one of the largest studies ever conducted on the issue. The report, titled Through Children’s Eyes: How Digital Technologies Enable Child Sexual Abuse, was released by UNICEF’s Office of Research this week. It draws on surveys of about 21,000 internet-using children aged 12 to 17, alongside in-depth interviews with 100 young people who experienced abuse in childhood. The research estimates that around 20 million children across the 21 countries surveyed were sexually exploited or abused through digital technologies in a single year. More than 15 million children were exposed to unwanted sexual content, more than 9 million were pressured into sexual conversations or asked to share sexual images, and about 4 million had sexual images shared without their consent. title: Thai AirAsia’s Silver Care offers seniors free perks
desc: Thai AirAsia’s Silver Care offers seniors free perks Legacy Thai AirAsia has launched Silver Care, a free service for passengers aged 60 and above on all its domestic flights in Thailand , the airline announced on September 2. The package includes priority check-in, priority baggage claim and a Seat Together service, which places a senior passenger next to a travelling companion, subject to standard seat availability. None of the three benefits carries an extra charge, and all apply across every domestic route the airline flies. Eligible passengers must present a valid ID card at the check-in counter. The privileges extend to one travel companion, meaning a senior passenger and a companion can check in together. At Don Mueang International Airport, Silver Care check-in takes place at a dedicated counter, 10J, in Domestic Terminal 2. Staff attach a special priority tag to checked luggage, which the airline said is intended to speed up baggage claim at the destination airport. desc: Phuket Marriott Merlin Beach adds new dining venues and family Splash Zone Legacy Phuket Marriott Resort & Spa, Merlin Beach has launched three new facilities, Kanpai, La Cala and the Splash Zone, to enhance the guest experience for leisure travellers and families staying at the beachfront resort in Phuket. The additions are designed to broaden the resort’s dining and recreational offering, giving guests more options for international cuisine and family activities without leaving the property. Travellers planning a beachfront stay can explore the resort’s latest facilities and reserve accommodation through the official Marriott website . La Cala introduces a refined Italian dining experience to the resort, with a menu focused on premium ingredients and authentic Italian dishes. The venue is designed for guests looking for an elegant setting for evening dining during their stay. La Cala Kanpai adds a Japanese dining option to the resort’s culinary line-up. The outlet offers traditional Japanese flavours and dishes prepared with attention to detail, giving guests another international dining choice within the property. title: รัฐบาลเร่งสำรวจบ้านไม่มีเลขที่ รองรับระบบประกันภัยพิบัติแห่งชาติ มุ่งช่วยเหลือหากเกิดภัยพิบัติ
desc: รัฐบาลเดินหน้าเร่งสำรวจครัวเรือน “ไม่มีเลขที่บ้าน” รองความช่วยเหลือ–ระบบประกันภัยพิบัติแห่งชาติ มุ่งให้ประชาชนได้รับการช่วยเหลือเยียวยาหากเกิดภัยพิบัติ อย่างครอบคลุมและทั่วถึง

summary_cn: 泰国政府加紧推进对无门牌号住宅的普查工作，以配合国家灾害保险制度的全面运行。该措施旨在建立完整的住户登记档案，确保在发生自然灾害或突发事件时，全国人民都能及时获得保险赔付和政府救助，实现救灾工作的全面覆盖和公平分配。

desc: สมาคมอุตสาหกรรมยานยนต์ไทย (TAIA) ร่วมกับกระทรวงพลังงาน ยืนยันความพร้อมรถยนต์และรถจักรยานยนต์ รองรับการใช้น้ำมัน E20 และ B20 เสริมสร้างความมั่นคงด้านพลังงานของประเทศ
title_cn: 泰国汽车协会与能源部宣布：车辆已准备支持E20和B20新燃料标准
summary_cn: 泰国汽车工业协会（TAIA）与能源部联合确认，国内汽车和摩托车产业已做好充分准备，可支持使用E20乙醇混合汽油和B20生物柴油。此举旨在增强国家能源安全，减少对进口燃料的依赖，同时推动绿色能源战略。这表明泰国汽车制造业已具备应对新燃料标准的技术能力。

title: Police seize fake memory cards
desc: PATHUM THANI: Police have seized 16,245 counterfeit memory cards after complaints that fake products sold online caused severe damage to customers' data and computer systems.
title_cn: 警方查获1.6万余张假冒内存卡
summary_cn: 泰国北标府（Pathum Thani）警方查获16,245张假冒存储卡。这批产品通过网络渠道销售，导致消费者的数据安全和计算机系统受到严重损害。警方呼吁民众谨慎购买电子产品，并鼓励举报假冒商品销售线索，以打击不法产业链。
desc_original: PATHUM THANI: Police have seized 16,245 counterfeit memory cards after complaints that fake products sold online caused severe damage to customers' data and computer systems.

title: บอร์ดกสทช.ตีความคำสั่งศาลกันไปคนละทิศ กุมขมับ ! ประชุมบอร์ด 3 ก.ย. จะล่ม 8 นัดติดไหม

title_cn: 通信委员会董事会对法院命令理解分歧加剧，9月3日会议能否如期召开成焦点
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）董事会成员对法院命令的理解产生分歧。相关人士表示该事已进入司法程序，呼吁继续推进工作；另一方强调法院已就涉事人员下台问题做出裁决。舆论担心定于9月3日召开的董事会会议是否会连续第8次流产，引发监管机构运作的担忧。

title: 151 arrested in e-cigarette blitz
desc: Cyber police arrested 151 suspects and seized more than 140 million baht over the past year in a crackdown on illegal e-cigarette networks.
title_cn: 警方查获非法电子烟网络，一年内逮捕151人缴获1.4亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国网络警察在打击非法电子烟网络的专项行动中，过去一年逮捕151名嫌疑人，缴获超过1.4亿泰铢。此举反映泰国政府对非法烟草制品的严厉态度。电子烟在泰国属于管制产品，违法进口和贩售者将面临严重处罚，外国人亦需注意相关法律。
desc_original: Cyber police arrested 151 suspects and seized more than 140 million baht over the past year in a crackdown on illegal e-cigarette networks.

summary_cn: 昵称「背包客阿姨」的泰国退休旅行家Perm（Kanjanachai Pantharatecha）平静辞世。她以独自背包自助旅游享誉网络，积累大批粉丝，以积极乐观的生活态度和冒险精神著称。粉丝们在社交媒体上纷纷缅怀这位对年长者群体具有鼓舞意义的旅行家。

desc: โฆษกรัฐบาล เผย รัฐบาลเอาจริงคุมดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์ วันนี้ (3 ก.ย.) แจ้งความกรณีลอบเก็บน้ำมัน 2 แสนลิตร ขณะที่ “เอกนิติ” นัดประชุมบอร์ดดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์ นัดแรก 4 ก.ย. ปิดช่องโหว่ทั้งระบบ

summary_cn: 泰国政府表示正在严肃整治数据中心管理。今日（9月3日）针对某数据中心非法贮存20万升燃油一案申报处罚。政府数字经济和社会部长Ekachai宣布数据中心管理委员会首次会议定于9月4日召开，将系统性填补管理漏洞，确保关键基础设施安全运营。

title: Thai stocks face triple threat, according to ASPS
desc: Asia Plus Securities (ASPS) has identified three major risks weighing on Thai equities after the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index fell below 1,600 points amid renewed geopolitical concerns and domestic uncertainty.
title_cn: 泰国股市面临三重威胁，SET指数跌破1600点
summary_cn: Asia Plus证券公司（ASPS）警示泰国股市正面临三大主要风险。泰国证券交易所（SET）指数近期跌破1600点，受地缘政治紧张升级和国内政治经济不确定性双重因素冲击。投资者需密切关注这些宏观风险因素对股市走势和投资组合的持续影响。
desc_original: Asia Plus Securities (ASPS) has identified three major risks weighing on Thai equities after the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index fell below 1,600 points amid renewed geopolitical concerns and domestic uncertainty.

summary_cn: AWC 与环球影业（Universal）合作，在 Aquatica 芭提雅（Pattaya）水上乐园打造泰国首家梦工厂（DreamWorks）主题酒店，预计 2027 年第一季度开业，配套水上乐园设施，总投资逾 300 亿泰铢，目标吸引全球家庭游客。

title: ปัญหารถยนต์ไฟฟ้า ชาร์จแบบไหนไม่ดีต่อแบตเตอรี่
desc: ผู้เชี่ยวชาญด้านรถยนต์ไฟฟ้าและวิศวกรแบตเตอรี่ แนะนำให้ชาร์จไฟ 80% ในการใช้งานประจำวัน ไม่ต้องเต็ม 100% ไม่ว่าจะชาร์จด้วยไฟกระแสตรง DC หรือชาร์จ AC ผ่านไฟฟ้าภายในบ้าน
title_cn: 电动车充电秘诀：避免过度充电保护电池寿命
summary_cn: 电动车专家与电池工程师建议，日常使用应将电量充至 80%，无需充满 100%，无论采用直流快充（DC）或家用交流电（AC）充电方式。这一做法可延长电池寿命、降低故障风险。
desc_original: ผู้เชี่ยวชาญด้านรถยนต์ไฟฟ้าและวิศวกรแบตเตอรี่ แนะนำให้ชาร์จไฟ 80% ในการใช้งานประจำวัน ไม่ต้องเต็ม 100% ไม่ว่าจะชาร์จด้วยไฟกระแสตรง DC หรือชาร์จ AC ผ่านไฟฟ้าภายในบ้าน

title: Data gap clouds fate of wild bears
desc: A lack of reliable data on Thailand's wild bears is hampering efforts to track population declines and protect the animals as threats to their survival intensify.
title_cn: 数据缺陷威胁泰国野生熊保护前景
summary_cn: 泰国缺乏关于野生熊种群的可靠数据，这成为追踪种群数量下降和保护这一物种的重大障碍。随着威胁加剧，无法准确掌握现状令保护工作举步维艰，亟需建立完整的监测体系。
desc_original: A lack of reliable data on Thailand's wild bears is hampering efforts to track population declines and protect the animals as threats to their survival intensify.

title: Local speciality coffee market grows
desc: The Thai speciality coffee segment is growing, with several local brands expanding their stores and foreign brands entering the market.
title_cn: 泰国精品咖啡市场蓬勃发展，本地与国际品牌齐头并进
summary_cn: 泰国精品咖啡市场持续增长，本地咖啡品牌加快开店扩张，同时国际咖啡品牌也相继入场。这反映出泰国消费者对高质量咖啡的需求上升，精品咖啡文化日益普及。
desc_original: The Thai speciality coffee segment is growing, with several local brands expanding their stores and foreign brands entering the market.

title: Thais reluctant to give AI 'complete control'
desc: Some Thais may be embracing services powered by artificial intelligence (AI), but they are not ready to hand over control, with only 10% willing to let AI act by default and nearly a quarter refusing to use it at all.
title_cn: 泰国人不愿让人工智能「完全掌控」
summary_cn: 虽然部分泰国人接受人工智能（AI）驱动的服务，但大多数人对 AI 完全自主决策持谨慎态度。仅 10% 的泰国人愿意让 AI 默认自主行动，近四分之一的人则完全拒绝使用 AI 服务。这反映了泰国消费者对 AI 自主性和数据安全的担忧。
desc_original: Some Thais may be embracing services powered by artificial intelligence (AI), but they are not ready to hand over control, with only 10% willing to let AI act by default and nearly a quarter refusing to use it at all.

title: Thai refineries seek diesel export relief
desc: The Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) has renewed calls for the government to ease restrictions on diesel exports, warning that rising domestic stockpiles are pressuring oil refineries and could disrupt supply chains for key industrial sectors.
title_cn: 泰国炼油厂寻求柴油出口管制放宽
summary_cn: 泰国商业、工业与银行业联合常设委员会（JSCCIB）再次呼吁政府放宽柴油出口限制。国内柴油库存持续增加，正对炼油厂造成压力，可能影响关键工业部门的供应链。此举关系到泰国能源产业和相关产业链的稳定运作。
desc_original: The Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) has renewed calls for the government to ease restrictions on diesel exports, warning that rising domestic stockpiles are pressuring oil refineries and could disrupt supply chains for key industrial sectors.

title: Tourism, electronics set to power growth
desc: The tourism recovery and continued growth of the electronics market driven by the artificial intelligence (AI) boom are anticipated to support trade and the economy in the final quarter of this year, says a commerce official.
title_cn: 旅游与电子产业助力泰国经济增长
summary_cn: 泰国商务官员表示，第四季度经济增长将由旅游业复苏和电子产业持续增长两大引擎驱动，其中电子产业增长主要受人工智能（AI）产业繁荣的带动。这两大产业有望支撑泰国贸易与整体经济表现。
desc_original: The tourism recovery and continued growth of the electronics market driven by the artificial intelligence (AI) boom are anticipated to support trade and the economy in the final quarter of this year, says a commerce official.

title: Regulator tightens digital asset Travel Rule conditions
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has moved to tighten Travel Rule requirements for digital asset businesses, requiring them to collect, verify and retain information on transfers in order to strengthen safeguards against money laundering and technology-related crime.
title_cn: 监管部门严格数字资产「旅行规则」条件
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）收紧数字资产业务的「旅行规则」（Travel Rule）要求，强制企业收集、验证并保存交易转账信息。此举目在强化反洗钱和技术犯罪防范机制。该政策可能影响数字资产交易平台和从业机构的运营规范。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has moved to tighten Travel Rule requirements for digital asset businesses, requiring them to collect, verify and retain information on transfers in order to strengthen safeguards against money laundering and technology-related crime.

title: Data centres - Task force eager to capture benefits
desc: The private sector has established a data centre task force to maximise the economic benefits of the industry for both businesses and the public sector.
title_cn: 泰国私企成立数据中心工作组推进产业发展
summary_cn: 泰国私营部门已成立数据中心产业工作组，致力于最大化该产业对企业和公共部门的经济效益。这一举措反映泰国对 AI 和云计算产业发展机遇的重视，有助于把握数据中心产业的战略价值。
desc_original: The private sector has established a data centre task force to maximise the economic benefits of the industry for both businesses and the public sector.

title: DSI officers face investigation over exam fraud links
desc: Justice Minister Pol Lt Gen Rutthapon Naowarat has ordered an investigation into two Department of Special Investigation (DSI) officers allegedly linked to local-government exam fraud, while People's Party MP Rangsiman Rome examines possible wider political involvement.
title_cn: 特别调查局官员因考试舞弊接受调查
summary_cn: 司法部长鲁塔蓬·瑙瓦拉特下令调查特别调查局(DSI)两名官员与地方政府考试舞弊的关联，同时人民党议员兰西曼·罗姆正在审查是否存在更广泛的政治牵连。这起反腐调查涉及国家执法机构内部可能的腐败行为，可能揭示系统性问题。
desc_original: Justice Minister Pol Lt Gen Rutthapon Naowarat has ordered an investigation into two Department of Special Investigation (DSI) officers allegedly linked to local-government exam fraud, while People's Party MP Rangsiman Rome examines possible wider political involvement.

title: Pheu Thai dismisses coalition fears
desc: Pheu Thai Party (PT) leader Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed concerns over government instability, saying a dinner planned for coalition leaders on Sunday is intended to improve communication and coordinate government work, not prepare for a no-confidence debate.
title_cn: 为泰党打消联盟分裂忧虑
summary_cn: 为泰党领导人朱拉蓬·阿蒙维瓦特驳斥政府不稳定的担忧，表示周日联合政府领导人晚宴旨在改进沟通、协调政府工作，而非为不信任投票做准备。这些声明意在稳定当前执政联盟，缓解市场和民众对政治风险的担忧。
desc_original: Pheu Thai Party (PT) leader Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed concerns over government instability, saying a dinner planned for coalition leaders on Sunday is intended to improve communication and coordinate government work, not prepare for a no-confidence debate.

title: Parties agree on initial House targets
desc: The opposition has named Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob as initial no-confidence targets over concerns about government accountability and policy implementation.
title_cn: 反对派确定众议院弹劾初始目标
summary_cn: 反对派已确定总理阿努廷·詹维拉库尔和数字经济与社会部长柴猜诺克·奇差柯布为不信任投票的初始目标，理由是对政府问责制和政策执行的关切。此举反映泰国政治权力平衡状况，可能影响政府政策连贯性和稳定性。
desc_original: The opposition has named Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob as initial no-confidence targets over concerns about government accountability and policy implementation.

title: Fire-damaged site sealed for debris clean-up
desc: Authorities have declared the area surrounding the fire-damaged Khlong Thom Centre building a restricted fire zone as they move in to dismantle debris.
title_cn: 火灾受损隆隆通商场宣布隔离清理
summary_cn: 有关部门已将火灾受损的隆隆通商场(Khlong Thom Centre)周围区域宣布为限制火灾区，开始进行碎片清理工作。该商场是曼谷重要的商业中心，大火对周边地区的交通、空气质量和商业活动产生较大影响，清理工作预计将耗时较长。
desc_original: Authorities have declared the area surrounding the fire-damaged Khlong Thom Centre building a restricted fire zone as they move in to dismantle debris.

title: State infrastructure funds projected to raise B70bn
desc: State agencies are expected to raise nearly 70 billion baht through infrastructure funds next year, according to the State Enterprise Policy Office (Sepo).
title_cn: 国家基建基金明年融资目标700亿泰铢
summary_cn: 国家企业政策局预计，各国家机构明年通过基础设施基金融资近700亿泰铢。这些资金将支持泰国长期基础设施建设，包括交通、能源、水利等关键领域，对经济增长和就业创造具有重要推动作用。
desc_original: State agencies are expected to raise nearly 70 billion baht through infrastructure funds next year, according to the State Enterprise Policy Office (Sepo).

title: Court revives NBTC chief's qualification case
desc: The Supreme Administrative Court has overturned a lower court's refusal to hear a challenge by the chairman of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) against the NBTC selection committee's ruling on his qualifications.
title_cn: 最高行政法院恢复NBTC主席资格案审理
summary_cn: 泰国最高行政法院推翻下级法院的裁决，允许国家广播和电信委员会（NBTC）主席萨拉纳对委员会选拔小组关于其资格认定的决议提出质证。该案涉及NBTC领导权争议和法律程序问题，可能影响委员会的正常运作。
desc_original: The Supreme Administrative Court has overturned a lower court's refusal to hear a challenge by the chairman of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) against the NBTC selection committee's ruling on his qualifications.

title: Latest NBTC board meeting likely to be called off again
desc: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission's (NBTC) board meeting scheduled for Thursday is likely to be aborted again as some commissioners still insist they will not attend the meeting if chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck is present.
title_cn: NBTC董事会会议恐再度流产
summary_cn: 国家广播和电信委员会原定周四召开的董事会会议可能再次被迫取消。多名委员坚持，若主席萨拉纳博士出席会议，他们将拒不参加。这反映NBTC内部因主席资格问题引发的严重分歧和管理危机。
desc_original: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission's (NBTC) board meeting scheduled for Thursday is likely to be aborted again as some commissioners still insist they will not attend the meeting if chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck is present.

title: Low-carbon shift 'a growth engine'
desc: The low-carbon transition should be treated as a new growth engine for Thailand rather than an environmental obligation, Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) co-chairman Payong Srivanich said on Wednesday.
title_cn: 低碳转型成为泰国经济增长新引擎
summary_cn: 泰国商业、工业和银行业联合常设委员会主席帕永·斯里瓦尼奇表示，低碳转型应被视为泰国经济的新增长引擎，而非仅限环保义务。这反映泰国产业界对绿色经济转型的战略认可，标志着产业政策向可持续发展方向调整。
desc_original: The low-carbon transition should be treated as a new growth engine for Thailand rather than an environmental obligation, Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) co-chairman Payong Srivanich said on Wednesday.

title: US sailors warmly welcomed in Pattaya
desc: More than 5,000 US Navy personnel from the USS Abraham Lincoln have begun making their way into Pattaya, where they are expected to pour about 100 million baht into the local economy during five days of long-overdue shore leave.
title_cn: 美国海军在芭提雅受热烈欢迎
summary_cn: 超过5000名美国海军官兵从林肯号航空母舰（USS Abraham Lincoln）抵达泰国芭提雅（Pattaya），这是该舰队多年来首次长期登岸假期。官兵预计在5天内为当地经济注入约1亿泰铢，将大幅拉动当地餐饮、旅游、娱乐等服务业。此访也体现了美国与泰国军事关系的稳定发展。
desc_original: More than 5,000 US Navy personnel from the USS Abraham Lincoln have begun making their way into Pattaya, where they are expected to pour about 100 million baht into the local economy during five days of long-overdue shore leave.

title: Bangkok halts new data centre approvals
desc: No more licences will be issued for new data centres in Bangkok, governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Wednesday, responding to growing concerns about potential negative impacts associated with the facilities.
title_cn: 曼谷暂停新数据中心审批
summary_cn: 曼谷市长差查·西提蒲（Chadchart Sittipunt）宣布停止向新的数据中心颁发营业许可证。该决定源于市政府对数据中心可能造成负面影响的日益关注，包括大幅增加电力需求、能耗、碳排放以及对城市基础设施的压力。这一政策调整反映了曼谷在平衡科技产业发展与城市可持续性方面的新态度。
desc_original: No more licences will be issued for new data centres in Bangkok, governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Wednesday, responding to growing concerns about potential negative impacts associated with the facilities.

summary_cn: 受中东冲突和全球通胀压力影响，债券收益率大幅上升，市场预期美联储可能加快加息步伐。但若用「收入收益率差」（股票收益率减去债券收益率）来衡量股市价值，泰国、韩国、越南等亚洲市场相对便宜，在利率上升环境下仍具投资机会。分析人士建议投资者在此环境下重新评估资产配置。

title: Phitsanulok woman turns cockroaches into fishing bait business
desc: Phitsanulok woman turns cockroaches into fishing bait business Legacy A Thai woman in Phitsanulok province turned cockroach farming into a profitable business, supplying live insects as fishing bait to river anglers and earning more than 100,000 baht per month. The 29 year old Thai woman, Nattaliya Amahasimae, runs a cockroach farm in Chum Saeng Songkhram, Bang Rakam, Phitsanulok. Nattaliya shared her business journey in an interview with Thai news agencies, saying her family lives near the Yom River, where many anglers catch cockroaches to use as fishing bait. She said anglers told her that cockroaches worked better as bait than other insects and shrimp. After learning about the demand, Nattaliya began researching how to breed cockroaches and operate a farm. Photo via Facebook/ Phitsanulok Hotnews Nattaliya discovered that raising cockroaches was not difficult and decided to start her own farm. She said she takes care of the cockroaches in a similar way to other farmed animals. The insects are raised in suitable conditions and kept clean, fed high-quality chicken feed, and given fresh water every week. Nattaliya shared her business journey in an interview with Thai news agencies, saying her family lives near the Yom River, where many anglers catch cockroaches to use as fishing bait. She said anglers told her that cockroaches worked better as bait than other insects and shrimp. After learning about the demand, Nattaliya began researching how to breed cockroaches and operate a farm. Photo via Facebook/ Phitsanulok Hotnews Nattaliya discovered that raising cockroaches was not difficult and decided to start her own farm. She said she takes care of the cockroaches in a similar way to other farmed animals. The insects are raised in suitable conditions and kept clean, fed high-quality chicken feed, and given fresh water every week. title: Armed student restrained in Kamphaeng Phet school shooting
desc: Armed student restrained in Kamphaeng Phet school shooting Legacy A teenage student allegedly brought a 9mm pistol into a secondary school in Kamphaeng Phet’s Nakhon Chum area and opened fire during a school shooting today, September 2, before being restrained , according to unconfirmed local social media reports. No injuries or deaths have been reported, and police are continuing to investigate. The incident was reported at approximately 2pm today at Wachirapragarn Wittayakom School, according to a post from a local Facebook page. The page stated that teachers, police, rescue workers, and members of the public helped restrain the individual involved and recovered the firearm at the scene. It added that there were no reported deaths. A separate Facebook page belonging to a person identifying as a rescue worker said the individual involved is a 15 year old student who allegedly brought the firearm into the school with intent to carry out an attack. The report claimed he asked for a teacher and fired the weapon seven to eight times before rescue personnel talked him down and he surrendered the firearm. Firearm used in the school shooting | Photo via Facebook/กำแพงเพชร ร้องเรียน

title: Bolt suspends driver, investigates ghostly decorated car
desc: Bolt suspends driver, investigates ghostly decorated car Legacy Bolt has suspended a driver from its platform while investigating a passenger’s complaint about a strangely decorated car that featured ghostly faces on the front-seat headrests. The ride-hailing company confirmed it received the passenger’s report and has since contacted her for more information. “We can confirm that Bolt received the passenger’s report and is investigating the incident. We understand that the experience was distressing, and we regret that the passenger felt their concerns were not taken seriously. “Our team has contacted the passenger to request further information and is awaiting a response. The driver’s access to the Bolt platform has been suspended while we investigate and confirm that the vehicle meets our safety and roadworthiness requirements. “Appropriate action will be taken based on the outcome of the review. The safety and comfort of everyone using our platform remain our priority.” Photo via Facebook: We Are Consumers Photo via Facebook: We Are Consumers The response follows a Facebook post from yesterday, September 1, about unusual decorations inside a Bolt car. title: 5 accounting mistakes foreign business owners make when setting up an ERP in Thailand
desc: 5 accounting mistakes foreign business owners make when setting up an ERP in Thailand Legacy The ERP implementation is finished. The sales pipeline works, inventory reconciles, and the dashboards look exactly as they did in the demo. Then the seventh of the month arrives, the accountant asks for the PND 53, and someone discovers that the system, which cost several hundred thousand baht and four months of collective effort, does not produce one. This is not a failure of the ERP software. Odoo, for instance, is a genuinely capable platform, and for a growing company in Thailand it is often the right choice: one system covering accounting, inventory, sales and payroll at a fraction of what traditional mid-market ERPs charge. The problem is narrower than that. Thai ERP projects break at the seam between the software and the Revenue Department. 1. title: USS Abraham Lincoln off-limits to visitors at Laem Chabang Port
desc: USS Abraham Lincoln off-limits to visitors at Laem Chabang Port Legacy People have been asked not to visit Laem Chabang Port to see the USS Abraham Lincoln after the US Navy aircraft carrier docked in Chon Buri this morning , September 2, with heightened security measures in place . Laem Chabang Port deputy director Weerachat Phuttharaksa said the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier is a US military vessel requiring a high level of security throughout its stay. Security arrangements have been divided between government agencies, relevant officers and personnel responsible for security within Laem Chabang Port. Photo via MGR Online Weerachat said patrols inside the port have been increased, while existing security measures have also been tightened following the arrival of the USS Abraham Lincoln . The deputy director acknowledged that people may be interested in visiting the port to see the large aircraft carrier but said areas near the vessel cannot be opened to the public because of the security requirements. “We sincerely apologise that we cannot accommodate visitors or allow the public to come in and see the ship due to security requirements,” Weerachat said. Photo by Sakchai Lalit

title: 首批1520辆，曼谷电动公交车明年投入使用
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月1日，泰国曼谷公共交通管理局（BMTA）局长吉提功透露，曼谷公交“换新”第一期的1520辆电动公交车采购项目进展顺利，预计于2027年3月底前接收首批500辆，4月底再接收第二批500辆，最后一批520辆在2027年5月底到位。据悉，该项目旨在提升曼谷公共的服务标准，并解决机构长期累积的债务问题。 目前，前40辆车的主要零部件已运抵Energy Absolute（EA）公司的生产工厂，其最高日产能为15辆，高于BMTA日产12辆的目标，已完成的两辆样车主要用于测试安全系统、路况适应性和培训驾驶员。在今年9月24日BMTA成立50周年当天，将展出一辆已通过检查的样车，并开放员工实际试驾。 这次的调整将以一比一的方式，将现有的普通公交车（红白车）全部替换为政府政策支持的清洁能源空调车，第一期计划投入约50条线路，“换新”总路线共107条。重点线路集中在市区环线，如191路（Ratchadapisek-Ramkhamhaeng），以及商业中心区（CBD），包括Silom、Bangrak、Khlong Toei和Rama 4等，还有连接郊区的线路。这些线路平时日均载客约55万至65万人次，节假日约30万至40万人次，票价在15至25泰铢之间，符合陆路运输厅对空调车的收费标准。同时，政府正在研究通过联程票价系统和国民福利卡，帮助民众减轻负担。 吉提功表示，BMTA已制定第二期再采购800辆电动公交车的计划，预算超过80亿泰铢。该计划已提交众议院审议，准备纳入年度支出预算，作为2027至2033年共7年的长期绑定预算。另外，第二期将沿用第一期的模式，所以推进速度会更快，预计2028年就能投入运营。 过去，BMTA长期面临债务和亏损累积，一部分原因是旧车每年的维护成本超过20亿泰铢，柴油费用每年约18亿泰铢。单体结构（Monocoque）的电动公交车身更轻、更结实，适合城市交通，每年电力成本约8亿泰铢，比原柴油费用大约低60%，且改用租赁模式后，维修责任也转给了租赁方。再加上采用新技术管理运营，人员开支再省9亿，预估每年可节省总运营成本达41亿泰铢，有助于可持续解决机构的财务问题。同时，BMTA将为每辆公交车安装监控摄像头和GPS追踪系统，进一步提升安全水平。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 首批1520辆，曼谷电动公交车明年投入使用 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 关于泰国调整免签政策的领事提醒
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 近日，泰国政府发布公告，调整免签入境停留期限，相关规定将于2026年9月15日起实施。中国驻泰国使馆经向泰方有关部门了解核实，现提醒如下： 一、泰方此次调整不影响中泰双边免签协定。泰方取消的是此前面向包括中国在内的93个国家和地区实施的单方面停留期60日免签政策。2024年3月1日起生效的《中华人民共和国政府与泰王国政府关于互免持普通护照人员签证协定》继续有效。 二、根据有关协定，中国公民持有效护照赴泰仍可享受免签待遇。自2026年9月15日起，以旅游、探亲及其他符合协定规定的事由，持公务普通护照、普通护照的中方人员仍可免签入境泰国，单次停留不超过30日（每180日累计停留不超过90日）。 三、免签不等于无条件入境。拟入境泰国从事工作、学习、新闻报道、定居等须事先批准的活动以及拟在泰停留超过30日的，须在入境泰国前办妥相应签证。入境时请确保护照有效期符合泰方要求，并按规定完成泰国电子入境卡申报。请遵守泰国移民法律法规及获准停留期限规定，切勿逾期居留或从事与入境事由不符的活动。 中国来泰公民如需领事协助，请联系： 外交部全球领事保护与服务应急热线（24小时）： +86-10-12308 +86-10-65612308 驻泰国使馆领事保护与协助电话： +66-2-245-7010 驻清迈总领馆领事保护与协助电话： +66-53-280-618 驻宋卡总领馆领事保护与协助电话： +66-81-766-5560 驻孔敬总领馆领事保护与协助电话： +66-80-936-6070 驻宋卡总领馆驻普吉领事办公室领事保护与协助电话： +66-94-595-6158 泰国报警电话：191 泰国旅游警察：1155（提供中文服务） （来源：中国驻泰国大使馆） The post 关于泰国调整免签政策的领事提醒 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国调整免签政策 中国公民单次停留期缩至30日
summary_cn: 泰国政府9月15日起调整免签入境政策。中泰《互免普通护照人员签证协定》继续有效，中国公民仍享受免签待遇，但单次停留期缩短至30日（每180日累计不超过90日），此前单方面60日免签政策已取消。工作、学习、新闻报道等需事先获准活动需办理相应签证。使馆提醒入境前确保护照有效期符合要求，完成电子入境卡申报。

title: 一中国男子在泰吸毒发疯，被捕后仍发狂
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月1日，泰国sutthisarn警察局接到报案称，辉煌区Samsennok街道Soi Ladprao 48巷一处公寓内有外籍男子情绪失控，遂派出行动小组前往现场。警方赶到后发现，中国籍嫌疑人王某（MR.WANG AN）正手持一把约10英寸长的刀，挥舞着来回走动，并举刀抵住自己的脖子威胁要自残。 行动小组多次警告王某放下刀具，并告知他将使用电击枪，但王某不听，继续大喊大叫，多次用刀抵住自己的脖子。随后，警方使用电击枪朝王某的右侧肋骨开了一枪，以制止其疯狂的行为，减少伤害。王某中枪后倒地，警方立即上前将其控制，并解除他手中的刀具。 在搜查房间时，警方还缴获了一袋冰毒和吸食冰毒的工具。报案人艾（化名）说，这些毒品和吸食工具都是王某的，他吸食后就会发狂，之前已多次动手打人，但今天情况比以往更严重，她感到不安全，才赶紧报警。 警方初步指控王某“未经许可非法持有第一类毒品（甲基苯丙胺或冰毒）”和“外国人未经许可进入泰国并停留”等罪名，在依法告知其权利后，已移交给sutthisarn警察局依法进一步处理。据悉，在警方将王某带往拘留室时，他再次发狂，用头猛撞牢房铁栏，大喊大叫且语无伦次，导致现场一阵混乱，警方不得不冲进去再次将他控制住，避免事态进一步扩大。 （编译：KA；来源：ch3plus） The post 一中国男子在泰吸毒发疯，被捕后仍发狂 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 中国籍男子在泰吸毒发狂 警方电击制服后仍暴力冲撞
summary_cn: 中国籍男子王某在曼谷某公寓吸毒后发狂，手持长刀威胁自残。警方到场劝阻无效后使用电击枪制服，并缴获冰毒和吸食工具。被带入拘留室后王某再次发狂，用头撞击铁栏导致现场混乱，警方再次出动控制局面。王某面临非法持有毒品和非法滞留罪名。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月1日，泰国sutthisarn警察局接到报案称，辉煌区Samsennok街道Soi Ladprao 48巷一处公寓内有外籍男子情绪失控，遂派出行动小组前往现场。警方赶到后发现，中国籍嫌疑人王某（MR.WANG AN）正手持一把约10英寸长的刀，挥舞着来回走动，并举刀抵住自己的脖子威胁要自残。 行动小组多次警告王某放下刀具，并告知他将使用电击枪，但王某不听，继续大喊大叫，多次用刀抵住自己的脖子。随后，警方使用电击枪朝王某的右侧肋骨开了一枪，以制止其疯狂的行为，减少伤害。王某中枪后倒地，警方立即上前将其控制，并解除他手中的刀具。 在搜查房间时，警方还缴获了一袋冰毒和吸食冰毒的工具。报案人艾（化名）说，这些毒品和吸食工具都是王某的，他吸食后就会发狂，之前已多次动手打人，但今天情况比以往更严重，她感到不安全，才赶紧报警。 警方初步指控王某“未经许可非法持有第一类毒品（甲基苯丙胺或冰毒）”和“外国人未经许可进入泰国并停留”等罪名，在依法告知其权利后，已移交给sutthisarn警察局依法进一步处理。据悉，在警方将王某带往拘留室时，他再次发狂，用头猛撞牢房铁栏，大喊大叫且语无伦次，导致现场一阵混乱，警方不得不冲进去再次将他控制住，避免事态进一步扩大。 （编译：KA；来源：ch3plus） The post 一中国男子在泰吸毒发疯，被捕后仍发狂 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Bangkok develops new policy to protect significant urban trees
desc: Bangkok develops new policy to protect significant urban trees Legacy The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) established regulations to protect “heritage trees” across the capital, with cutting, pruning or transplanting of registered trees requiring permission. BMA officials and relevant departments held a meeting yesterday, August 31, to establish a definition of “heritage trees” and develop measures to care for them according to international arboriculture standards. The trees will also be recorded in a city database. The meeting concluded that heritage trees must grow in public areas of Bangkok and be recognised based on their physical characteristics, role in urban ecology, or connections to history, culture and local communities. Officials then discussed guidelines for selecting heritage trees, with the assessment divided into two main categories. Photo via Facebook/ สำนักงานเขตคลองเตย The first covers physical characteristics. Trees should have an estimated age of at least 50 years or be an original tree. title: Pattaya’s US Navy preparations draw international attention
desc: Pattaya’s US Navy preparations draw international attention Legacy The upcoming visit of around 5,000 US Navy personnel to Pattaya attracted international media attention when The Independent published a report about prostitution laws in Thailand , wrongly describing prostitution as “ legal ”. The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier and two accompanying vessels are scheduled to dock at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri tomorrow, September 2 . Around 5,000 personnel are expected to remain in the area until September 6, with many expected to visit Pattaya and other parts of Chon Buri. Pattaya City officials have introduced security measures ahead of the visit, including a recent crackdown on prostitution and warnings to locals and foreign visitors that prostitution is illegal in Thailand. US Navy personnel have also been restricted from entering selected areas , including cannabis shops, pharmacies, Soi 6, Soi 6/1 and Soi 7. Water-based activities are also prohibited under the measures. The personnel will be allowed to visit Pattaya Walking Street but must leave the area by 2am. title_cn: 美国航母访泰引国际关注：芭提雅部署特别管理措施

title: Popular Thi Lo Su waterfall reopens in Tak
desc: TAK - The magnificent Thi Lo Su waterfall in Umphang district reopened to the public on Tuesday after being closed for two months to allow natural rehabilitation - but only for four-wheel-drive vehicles.
title_cn: 泰北蒂洛苏瀑布在达府重新开放迎客
summary_cn: 位于达府翁挽县的知名景点蒂洛苏瀑布(Thi Lo Su)在关闭两个月用于生态恢复后，于9月1日重新对游客开放。为保护环境，目前仅允许四轮驱动车辆通行，游客可驾车前往欣赏这一泰国北部的壮丽自然景观。

title: Jordanian tourist clashes with Phuket barber over extra charge
desc: Jordanian tourist clashes with Phuket barber over extra charge Legacy A dispute over a barber shop bill turned physical in Patong, Phuket , yesterday, August 31, after a Jordanian tourist allegedly refused to pay an additional charge for hair services. The incident first gained attention on social media, where a Facebook post claimed a foreign tourist had refused to pay for a haircut before punching the barber. The tourist was initially described online as Israeli. Patong Police later responded to a report of a fight near the end of Soi Bangla, where officers found the tourist and a barber shop employee grappling with each other. Police checks established that the tourist was Jordanian , not Israeli as claimed on social media. Photo via MGR Online According to the initial police inquiry, the tourist and the shop had earlier agreed on a price of 700 baht for a haircut. However, he later received additional hair services, resulting in an extra charge. When the work was finished, the tourist wanted to pay only the original 700 baht and attempted to leave the shop. title: 跑步、投球、打羽毛球！泰国另类抗议现场“举满参议员头像”
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 近日，泰国非政府组织iLaw联合多个民间团体，在位于Chaeng Watthana路的泰国政府办公中心大楼B栋前举行了一场别具象征意义的“体育主题抗议活动”，向泰国选举委员会（EC）施压，要求其对涉嫌操纵参议员选举的229名涉案人员全部提起公诉，不得有任何例外。 当天下午14时，参与者陆续到场，活动于14时29分正式启动。组织方要求参与者穿着非蓝色服装，并设置了三个体育项目：第一项为“登楼跑”，参与者在4楼的跑步机上完成2.29公里跑步；第二项为“将蓝色投进团体”，参与者需将球投入贴有被指控参议员姓名和照片的箱子，投中后可带走该箱；第三项为“羽毛球冠军赛”，以贴有10名泰自豪党相关部长照片的箱子为比赛目标，这些人士被指与案件有关。 每完成一个项目，参与者都会与贴有被指控人员照片的箱子合影。学者斯丽妮·阿差瓦南达库尔也到场，并带来了“揭穿宪法漏洞”游戏，进一步增加了活动的参与性与象征意义。以体育活动形式表达政治诉求，这在泰国民间抗议活动中并不多见，因而格外引人注目。 约15时10分，人权律师协会及相关网络组织代表宣读声明，呼吁选举委员会作为独立机构，履行监督与制衡权力的职责，不受任何干预。同时，他们要求司法程序中的相关人员和机制以公共利益为重，不应成为掌权者压制民众声音的工具。 iLaw组织主任英吉普表示，此次活动旨在敦促选举委员会对全部229名被指控人员提起诉讼，使相关事实与证据进入司法程序，交由法院审理。他明确表示：“如果选举委员会决定不起诉其中任何人，我们就有必要将相关人员的全部资料和详细信息向社会公开。” 英吉普还透露，原定于8月31日作出的表决已推迟至9月14日，他形容这相当于又增加了两周的“伤停补时”。在此期间，他呼吁民众继续调查各府参议员及参议员助理的背景，包括他们与政党的关系，以及可能涉及选举争议的相关信息，并将收集到的资料提交给iLaw。 此外，民众也可通过社交媒体参与行动，如发布相关信息、更换封面照片、使用标签 #สั่งฟ้องสว（要求起诉参议员），并以数字“229”唤起社会对案件规模的关注。 据了解，相关团体计划于9月13日（星期日）举行最后一次集会，在选举委员会预定表决前一天再次表达诉求，具体活动形式、时间及地点将于后续公布。 活动最后，参与者携带贴有被指控人员照片的箱子集体合影，并从大楼4楼阳台垂下写有“要求起诉参议员”字样的布条。 关于“操纵参议员选举”案件，涉及参议员选举舞弊及串谋操纵的指控，民间要求对229名被指控人员全部追究法律责任。这份名单是在选举委员会、审理委员会及泰国特别案件调查厅审查相关证据后形成的。 被指控人员主要分为两类：第一类是参议员及参议员候选人，共186人；第二类是政界人士及政党网络人员，共43人，涉嫌参与支持、策划或组织操纵选举。 民间团体及反对党的核心诉求包括：要求将229人全部移送

title: Pattaya pins hopes on arrival of 5,000 US sailors to boost tourism
desc: After more than 250 days at sea fighting the war on Iran – and amid reports of dire conditions on board – the USS Abraham Lincoln is finally set to dock near Pattaya this week, giving more than 5,000 American sailors and Marines shore leave as the Thai resort city hopes they will spend big during their last pit stop before home.
title_cn: 美国航母靠岸芭提雅 5000名海军官兵上岸休假拉动旅游消费
summary_cn: 美国亚伯拉罕·林肯号(USS Abraham Lincoln)航母经过250多天的中东作战后，计划本周靠岸芭提雅(Pattaya)，为5000多名美国海军官兵提供岸上休假。这是航母返航前的最后一站，芭提雅期待这批海外游客的消费将为本地旅游业注入经济活力。

title: SRT plans contingency for Airport Rail Link handover after exit notice
desc: SRT plans contingency for Airport Rail Link handover after exit notice Legacy The Airport Rail Link may face a temporary extension of two to three months while the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) works out how to keep trains running , Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn said, after the private operator submitted a letter seeking to exercise its right to halt services after September 30. To avoid disruption to passengers, the SRT governor is in talks to find a way forward. One option under discussion is extending the current operator’s services for two to three months to allow time for a transition. The SRT could then place the project under its subsidiary, S.R.T. Electrified Train Company Limited (SRTET). If the private operator confirms it will hand back the project as originally scheduled, the SRT says SRTET is ready to take over management immediately to keep services running without interruption. The SRT board is now working urgently to decide whether to hire a private company to help manage train operations for a period of six months to one year. The exact duration has yet to be finalised. title: Bryde’s whale ‘Mali’ dies from severe head, jaw injuries after impact
desc: Bryde’s whale ‘Mali’ dies from severe head, jaw injuries after impact Legacy A Bryde’s whale was found dead on the Samut Prakan coast on August 30, with a post-mortem examination later finding that it died from severe impact injuries to its head and jaw. The 10.7-metre whale was discovered near a seawall in Bang Pu subdistrict, Mueang Samut Prakan district. A team of veterinarians and marine experts examined the carcass the following day. The Department of Marine and Coastal Resources (DMCR) said the whale was a juvenile male that had been in good physical condition. Despite the carcass beginning to decompose and some parts being missing, its tissue and blubber remained between 2.8 and 4 centimetres thick. Photo via DMCR The examination found severe injuries around the head, including bruising, internal bleeding and a fractured upper jaw, with fragments of bone embedded in surrounding tissue. desc: Thai influencers find empty watch box inside damaged suitcase, case stalls Legacy Two Thai social media influencers sought legal assistance after two luxury watches worth 610,000 baht disappeared from their checked baggage during a flight from Bangkok to Krabi . The missing items included a Cartier watch worth around 470,000 baht and a Hermes watch worth 140,000 baht. Araya and Kunlanan said they noticed that the zipper on their suitcase was broken after collecting it. They decided to immediately check their belongings. title: Cries lead police to abandoned newborn in Chiang Mai
desc: Cries lead police to abandoned newborn in Chiang Mai Legacy A five-day-old baby girl was found abandoned in roadside grass in Chiang Mai early today, September 1, after a passerby heard her crying and alerted police. Doi Saket Police Station officers responded at about 5am in Choeng Doi subdistrict, Doi Saket district. After hearing cries coming from grass beside the road, officers used a torch to search the area and found the newborn lying on the ground . The baby had been wrapped in a brown towel and was crying when she was found. She was immediately taken to Doi Saket Hospital for examination and care. Photo via Doi Saket Police Station The baby was estimated to be about five days old. She was found to be in good health overall but was exhausted and remains under close care. Police have contacted the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security to arrange protection and care for the baby. Officers are reviewing CCTV footage from the area and surrounding routes to identify the person who left her there. title: Pattaya cannabis shop worker assaults Brit over fake payment slip
desc: Pattaya cannabis shop worker assaults Brit over fake payment slip Legacy A Pattaya cannabis shop employee yesterday, August 31, admitted to assaulting a British tourist after claiming the man used a fake bank transfer slip to avoid paying 29,200 baht for cannabis. Video of the confrontation, which occurred in Pattaya on the evening of August 30, circulated on social media. The footage showed the Thai employee holding the British man around the neck and punching him while stopping others from intervening. He also called the tourist a “thief” and demanded payment for the cannabis. Photo via MGR Online The employee, identified as 31 year old Ice, later said the dispute involved a 51 year old British man named Ryan. According to Ice, Ryan previously bought cannabis worth 29,200 baht and claimed he had transferred the payment. He sent the shop a transfer slip, but staff later determined that it was fake. Ice said the shop then filed a police complaint and posted a public warning before trying to locate Ryan for nearly a month. He eventually received information that Ryan had been spotted in Soi Bong Koch and went there, leading to the confrontation captured on video . Photo via MGR Onli
title_cn: 芭提雅大麻店员因虚假转账单殴打英国游客
summary_cn: 芭提雅大麻店员工 Ice（31 岁）因英国游客 Ryan（51 岁）用虚假银行转账单试图逃避支付 29,200 泰铢的大麻购买费用而发生冲突。事件发生在 8 月 30 日晚上，视频在社交媒体传播，显示店员对游客进行了暴力殴打。店员称已寻找该游客近一个月，在 Soi Bong Koch 发现他后发生争执。店员已承认殴打行为并向警方报案。

summary_cn: 泰国新的「员工福利基金」将于 10 月 1 日正式生效。该基金涉及员工工资扣除额度、雇主配缴比例、福利权益、成员资格要求以及离职时是否能退款等多方面内容。这是一项新的强制性福利制度，对泰国所有工薪族产生直接影响。受影响的员工需提前了解相关政策细节，及时掌握个人权益和义务。

title: 中国公民不受影响仍可停留60天，泰国收紧多国免签停留至30天
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月31日，泰国《政宪公报》网站发布内政部相关公告，共涉及4项关于免签及落地签政策调整的内容。其中，最受关注的是泰国正式取消自2024年7月15日起实施的针对93个国家和地区的60天免签政策。新规根据入境待遇的不同，将原有安排重新划分为3类，进一步收紧了外国游客在泰停留期限及入境条件。 第一类，60个国家和地区可免签入境，停留时间最多为30天。这些国家和地区包括澳大利亚、奥地利、巴林、比利时、保加利亚、不丹、文莱、加拿大、克罗地亚、塞浦路斯、捷克、丹麦、爱沙尼亚、斐济、芬兰、法国、格鲁吉亚、德国、希腊、匈牙利、冰岛、印度尼西亚、印度、爱尔兰、以色列、意大利、日本、约旦、科威特、吉尔吉斯斯坦、拉脱维亚、列支敦士登、立陶宛、卢森堡、马耳他、马来西亚、马尔代夫、荷兰、新西兰、挪威、阿曼、菲律宾、波兰、葡萄牙、卡塔尔、罗马尼亚、沙特阿拉伯、新加坡、斯洛伐克、斯洛文尼亚、南非、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士、中国台湾地区、土耳其、乌克兰、阿联酋、英国和美国。其中，通过陆路口岸入境泰国的，每个日历年原则上最多使用免签待遇2次，马来西亚、文莱、印度尼西亚和新加坡护照持有人以及部长另行指定的国家和地区除外。 第二类，2个国家可免签入境，停留时间最多为15天，分别为塞舌尔和毛里求斯。通过陆路口岸入境的，每个日历年原则上最多入境2次，部长另有规定的国家除外。 第三类，3个国家可申请落地签，包括阿塞拜疆、白俄罗斯和塞尔维亚。 此次政策调整的一个重要变化在于，新的30天和15天免签待遇明确限定为“以旅游为目的”。而此前实施的60天免签政策，除旅游外，还涵盖短期商务活动以及部分必要或紧急工作。 泰国政府此前表示，此次调整旨在堵塞安全漏洞，防止免签政策被滥用，同时在促进旅游、经济发展、国际关系及互惠原则之间寻求平衡。 根据新规，4项公告将在《政宪公报》网站发布15天后正式生效。在新规生效前已入境泰国的外国人，仍可按原获批的停留期限继续停留。 此外，不在上述名单中的国家和地区，其公民仍可依据双边免签协议入境泰国，或根据实际出行目的，通过e-Visa系统申请相应签证。目前，中国不在上述免签及落地签名单之列，中国公民赴泰仍按现行签证政策，单次停留60天执行。 （编译：Wan） The post 中国公民不受影响仍可停留60天，泰国收紧多国免签停留至30天 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国收紧免签政策至30天，中国公民仍可停留60天
summary_cn: 泰国正式取消自 2024 年 7 月实施的 93 国 60 天免签政策，重新划分为三类：60 个国家可免签停留 30 天、2 个国家 15 天、3 个国家可申请落地签。新政策明确限定免签目的为旅游，不再涵盖商务和工作。中国不在新名单中，中国公民赴泰仍按现行签证政策每次停留 60 天，不受此次调整影响。新规定将在《宪法公报》发布 15 天后生效。

title: SEC seeks public feedback on crypto ETF rules
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has opened a public consultation on proposed rules for cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (ETFs) in Thailand, aiming to expand investment choices, strengthen local market participation and promote greater product diversity in the capital market.
title_cn: 泰国证监会就加密ETF规则征求公众意见
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）启动公开咨询，就推出加密货币交易所交易基金（ETF）的监管规则征求公众意见。此举旨在扩大投资者选择、增强本地资本市场参与度、促进金融产品多元化，进一步完善泰国数字资产投资生态。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has opened a public consultation on proposed rules for cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (ETFs) in Thailand, aiming to expand investment choices, strengthen local market participation and promote greater product diversity in the capital market.

title: Airbus chooses Bangkok for digital HQ

title: Thailand's wellness boom raises oversupply concerns
desc: Although Thailand's health and wellness market is expanding, the pace of growth may be unhealthy and could lead to oversupply, according to The Absolute Group, a fitness and wellness services operator.
title_cn: 泰国养生产业繁荣 过度供应风险预警
summary_cn: 虽然泰国健康保健和健身市场持续增长，但扩张速度可能过快。业界运营商The Absolute Group警示，市场增长步伐不够健康，可能导致供应过剩，行业面临调整压力。业内呼吁谨慎评估市场容量和发展节奏。
desc_original: Although Thailand's health and wellness market is expanding, the pace of growth may be unhealthy and could lead to oversupply, according to The Absolute Group, a fitness and wellness services operator.

title: ชง ครม.สัญจรเคาะงบ 1 หมื่นล้าน  20 ล้านครัวเรือนเฮ! รัฐซื้อประกันภัยพิบัติลดเสี่ยง

title_cn: 政府推行巨灾保险计划 2000万户家庭获保障
summary_cn: 农业部与财政部提交国务院批准，拟推行20亿泰铢巨灾保险计划，覆盖2000万家庭。洪水赔付标准为洪水后7日内赔1万泰铢，房屋损毁最高赔10万泰铢，身故赔付200万泰铢，旨在降低自然灾害风险。

title: พาณิชย์รุกจัดกิจกรรม GI Journey ยกระดับสินค้าท้องถิ่นสู่วัตถุดิบระดับพรีเมียม
desc: กรมทรัพย์สินทางปัญญา ปลุกกระแสวัตถุดิบ GI ไทย จัดกิจกรรม “GI Journey: Taste Map of Thailand” ต่อยอดใช้ประโยชน์จากสินค้า GI สร้างรายได้ให้ชุมชนอย่างยั่งยืน
title_cn: 商业部推进地理标志产品价值升级
summary_cn: 泰国知识产权局推出「GI Journey: Taste Map of Thailand」活动，旨在提升泰国地理标志原产地商品的价值链，将本地特产转化为高端原料，促进社区可持续增收。计划重点开发泰国GI农产品的商业潜力。
desc_original: กรมทรัพย์สินทางปัญญา ปลุกกระแสวัตถุดิบ GI ไทย จัดกิจกรรม “GI Journey: Taste Map of Thailand” ต่อยอดใช้ประโยชน์จากสินค้า GI สร้างรายได้ให้ชุมชนอย่างยั่งยืน

title: Operators seek reforms to Thailand's wellness ecosystem to welcome non-Thai massage
desc: Wellness operators are calling for labour law reform to allow foreigners to work as non-Thai massage therapists as well as licensing mobile massage services in order to make Thailand a top global wellness hub.
title_cn: 泰国保健业呼吁改革法规 允许外国按摩师执业
summary_cn: 泰国保健业经营者呼吁修改劳动法规，以允许外国人从事非泰式按摩工作，并推动流动按摩服务许可制。此举旨在吸引国际人才，巩固泰国在全球保健产业的领先地位，提升产业竞争力。
desc_original: Wellness operators are calling for labour law reform to allow foreigners to work as non-Thai massage therapists as well as licensing mobile massage services in order to make Thailand a top global wellness hub.

title: Energy officials promote biofuels as primary fuels
desc: Thailand is stepping up efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in its transport sector by promoting biofuels as primary fuels, according to the Department of Energy Business (DOEB).
title_cn: 泰国能源部门推动生物燃料作为主要燃料
summary_cn: 泰国能源业发展部表示，泰国正加大力度推广生物燃料作为交通运输部门的主要燃料，以减少温室气体排放。该政策旨在降低碳排放，实现环保目标，推动绿色能源转型。
desc_original: Thailand is stepping up efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in its transport sector by promoting biofuels as primary fuels, according to the Department of Energy Business (DOEB).

title: Police told to pay up over false arrest
desc: The Supreme Court has ordered the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to pay 4.38 million baht in compensation to Ritrong Cheunjit, ending a 17-year legal battle over his wrongful arrest and torture in 2009.
title_cn: 泰国最高法院判令警方赔偿冤案受害者
summary_cn: 泰国最高法院判决皇家警察部门向受害者Ritrong Cheunjit支付438万泰铢赔偿金，终结长达17年的司法诉讼。该案涉及2009年的非法逮捕和刑讯逼供，标志着泰国冤案救济制度的重要胜利。
desc_original: The Supreme Court has ordered the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to pay 4.38 million baht in compensation to Ritrong Cheunjit, ending a 17-year legal battle over his wrongful arrest and torture in 2009.

title: Defence chief in Pattani to hear security concerns
desc: Pattani: Defence Minister Lt Gen Adul Boonthamcharoen on Monday visited the Internal Security Operations Command Region 4 Forward Command in this southernmost border province to hear directly from personnel on the ground.
title_cn: 国防部长赴巴真听取安全问题汇报
summary_cn: 国防部长阿都·蒙达查龙中将视察位于泰国最南方边境省份巴真的第四区前线内安作战指挥部，听取基层人员对安全问题的意见。
desc_original: Pattani: Defence Minister Lt Gen Adul Boonthamcharoen on Monday visited the Internal Security Operations Command Region 4 Forward Command in this southernmost border province to hear directly from personnel on the ground.

title: Major reservoir plan sparks public protest
desc: Chanthaburi: Residents and civil society networks are preparing to stage a major rally outside the provincial hall on Sept 13 to oppose the Khlong Wang Tanot reservoir project, following the cabinet's approval of a 7.2-billion-baht budget for the scheme.
title_cn: 大型水库项目引发公众抗议
summary_cn: 尖竹汶省居民和民间组织将于9月13日在省政府大楼外举行大规模集会，反对政府批准的王涛隆水库项目。该项目获内阁核准72亿泰铢预算。
desc_original: Chanthaburi: Residents and civil society networks are preparing to stage a major rally outside the provincial hall on Sept 13 to oppose the Khlong Wang Tanot reservoir project, following the cabinet's approval of a 7.2-billion-baht budget for the scheme.

title: Data centre growth sparks health fears
desc: A rapid expansion of the data centre industry could pose health and environmental risks to nearby communities, an expert has warned.
title_cn: 数据中心快速扩张引发健康隐忧
summary_cn: 专家警告，泰国数据中心产业的快速扩张可能对周边社区的健康和环境造成风险。
desc_original: A rapid expansion of the data centre industry could pose health and environmental risks to nearby communities, an expert has warned.

title: Bulbul breeding rules ease
desc: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has signed a regulation removing the red-whiskered bulbul (nok krong hua juk) from the protected wildlife list.
title_cn: 黄须阿鹎饲养规定放宽
summary_cn: 自然资源与环保部长素查特签署新规，将红嘴黄须阿鹎（泰语称「nok krong hua juk」）从野生动物保护名录中删除。
desc_original: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has signed a regulation removing the red-whiskered bulbul (nok krong hua juk) from the protected wildlife list.

title: 22 reservoirs overflow in heavy rains
desc: Authorities have warned of heavy to very heavy rain across upper Thailand through tomorrow, raising the risk of flash floods and forest runoff.
title_cn: 22座水库因暴雨溢满
summary_cn: 当局发布警报，泰国北部地区将持续暴雨至明天，可能引发山洪和森林径流，22座水库溢满。
desc_original: Authorities have warned of heavy to very heavy rain across upper Thailand through tomorrow, raising the risk of flash floods and forest runoff.

title: Senate vote clears emergency energy loan
desc: The Senate on Monday approved the executive decree authorising the Finance Ministry to borrow 400 billion baht to address the energy crisis and finance the country's energy transition, with 135 senators voting in favour, 11 against and 28 abstaining.
title_cn: 参议院批准紧急能源贷款法案
summary_cn: 泰国参议院周一表决批准行政令，授权财政部借款400亿泰铢用于应对当前能源危机和推进国家能源转型。投票结果为135票赞成、11票反对、28票弃权，表明议会对该重大能源政策的广泛支持。这笔资金将强化泰国能源安全。
desc_original: The Senate on Monday approved the executive decree authorising the Finance Ministry to borrow 400 billion baht to address the energy crisis and finance the country's energy transition, with 135 senators voting in favour, 11 against and 28 abstaining.

title: Viriyah's non-motor business surges 18%
desc: Viriyah Insurance has seen significant growth in its non-motor insurance business as more frequent and severe floods and earthquakes increase risks and costs across the property and casualty (P&C) insurance market, prompting greater public awareness of natural disasters.
title_cn: 威瑞亚保险非汽车业务增长18%
summary_cn: 由于水灾和地震等自然灾害频繁且程度加剧，泰国财产保险和意外伤害保险市场面临更大风险和成本压力。威瑞亚保险公司的非汽车保险业务实现18%的显著增长，反映公众对自然灾害防范意识的提升和保险需求的增加。
desc_original: Viriyah Insurance has seen significant growth in its non-motor insurance business as more frequent and severe floods and earthquakes increase risks and costs across the property and casualty (P&C) insurance market, prompting greater public awareness of natural disasters.

title: Ukraine wants winter aid as war drags on
desc: Ukraine has urged Thailand to provide more humanitarian aid ahead of winter, while calling for greater Thai involvement in reconstruction and efforts to return Ukrainian children taken during the war.
title_cn: 乌克兰呼吁泰国加强冬季援助
summary_cn: 乌克兰政府敦促泰国在寒冬季节前加强人道主义援助，同时呼吁泰国在战后重建和解救被掳乌克兰儿童方面加大参与力度。这反映了乌克兰长期战争背景下对国际社会支持的迫切需求。
desc_original: Ukraine has urged Thailand to provide more humanitarian aid ahead of winter, while calling for greater Thai involvement in reconstruction and efforts to return Ukrainian children taken during the war.

title: Krok E-Dok waterfall shut for two days
desc: SARABURI: Khao Yai National Park closed Krok E-Dok waterfall in Kaeng Khoi district from Monday to Tuesday after heavy upstream rain caused flash floods and strong currents.
title_cn: 考艾国家公园克洛克·埃多克瀑布临时关闭
summary_cn: 位于沙拉武里（Saraburi）府凯叻（Kaeng Khoi）县的考艾国家公园（Khao Yai National Park）内克洛克·埃多克瀑布因上游暴雨引发山洪和急流，自周一至周二临时关闭以确保游客安全。游客应避免在恶劣天气期间前往该景区游览。
desc_original: SARABURI: Khao Yai National Park closed Krok E-Dok waterfall in Kaeng Khoi district from Monday to Tuesday after heavy upstream rain caused flash floods and strong currents.

title: Global bond rates threaten Thai market
desc: Global bond yields, geopolitical tensions and corporate credit quality pose risks to Thailand's bond market, which is expected to remain relatively stable in the second half of the year, supported by expectations that the Bank of Thailand will keep its policy rate unchanged, says the Thai Bond Market Association (ThaiBMA).
title_cn: 全球债券收益率威胁泰国债市
summary_cn: 泰国债券市场协会警示全球债券收益率上升、地缘政治局势紧张和企业信用质量恶化等多重因素对泰国债市构成风险。市场预期下半年将保持相对稳定，主要得益于泰国央行预计维持政策利率不变，为债市提供有力支撑。
desc_original: Global bond yields, geopolitical tensions and corporate credit quality pose risks to Thailand's bond market, which is expected to remain relatively stable in the second half of the year, supported by expectations that the Bank of Thailand will keep its policy rate unchanged, says the Thai Bond Market Association (ThaiBMA).

summary_cn: 泰国政府高层官员完成南方考察后进行轻松联谊活动。两名官员阿努廷和也颂差南轮流献唱展示歌艺，另一官员素帕玛斯现场亲密示好表达支持。

desc: เศร้า ผลชันสูตร "วาฬบรูด้า" บางปูเกยตื้นตาย มีร่องรอยบาดแผลฉกรรจ์ภายในจากแรงกระแทกของเรือ โดนส่วนหัวและขากรรไกร คาดตัวเคราะห์ร้ายคือ "เจ้ามาลี" ลูกวาฬตัวที่ 6 ของแม่กันยา
title_cn: 布氏鲸搁浅身亡，疑遭船只撞击
summary_cn: 一只布氏鲸在邦普搁浅后不幸身亡。尸检发现其头部与下颌存在致命创伤，伤势特征表明系轮船撞击所致。初步推断为名叫「查玛丽」的鲸鱼，系其母亲根雅生育的第六只幼鲸。

title: Southern shortcut bridges get go-ahead
desc: Plans have been put into motion by the government to build two major bridges in the nation's southern region with an aim to improve transport connectivity, support tourism and stimulate local economic activity.
title_cn: 泰国南部快速通道桥梁工程获批
summary_cn: 泰国政府批准在南方地区建设两座主干道桥梁项目，旨在改善区域交通运输连接、促进旅游发展和刺激地方经济增长。该基础设施投资有望显著提升南方地区交通便利性与经济活力。
desc_original: Plans have been put into motion by the government to build two major bridges in the nation's southern region with an aim to improve transport connectivity, support tourism and stimulate local economic activity.

title: Psychological support prepared as school resumes classes after shooting incident
desc: Debsirin Nonthaburi School has prepared to provide psychological support for up to one year after it resumes on-site classes on Tuesday following a tragic shooting incident on Aug 7.
title_cn: 暖武里校园枪击后恢复上课，启动长期心理援助
summary_cn: 德斯瑞校园暖武里分校在8月7日发生枪击悲剧后，定于周二恢复现场教学。学校已准备心理咨询支持服务，为全校师生提供长达一年的心理援助，协助创伤恢复。
desc_original: Debsirin Nonthaburi School has prepared to provide psychological support for up to one year after it resumes on-site classes on Tuesday following a tragic shooting incident on Aug 7.

title: สรุปเคส “ไฟไหม้คลองถม”  มีทุนประกันหลักร้อยล้าน พอไหม? อ่านคำแนะนำตรงจาก คปภ. ก่อนซื้อประกันภัย

title_cn: 「打浪中心」火灾保险赔偿解读：保额够吗？保监部门建议一览
summary_cn: 8月28日曼谷打浪中心（Klongtoey Center）发生重大火灾事故，大量民众和商家受损。事故引发关于保险覆盖范围的广泛关注。保险监管部门（OIC）提醒消费者，火灾保险的保额设置至关重要，并非所有损失都能获得完整赔偿。本文整理了此案涉及的保险基础知识和专业建议，帮助民众在投保前充分了解条款内容，确保自身权益。

title: Chiang Mai couple charged 85,800 baht without consent at beauty clinic
desc: Chiang Mai couple charged 85,800 baht without consent at beauty clinic Legacy A Thai couple accused a beauty clinic inside a shopping mall in Chiang Mai of charging 85,800 baht to their credit card without consent after they were invited to try a free treatment. The couple’s daughter shared the allegations on Facebook yesterday, August 30, asking an online community for advice. According to KhaoSod, the clinic was located on the fourth floor of the shopping mall. The daughter said the incident happened on August 16. Her parents were approached by clinic staff standing outside the shop, who invited them to try a service for free. The couple agreed to take part. According to her father’s account, his wife was taken into a treatment room while staff members asked him for his credit card. He questioned why the card was needed if the service was free. Photo by the couple’s daughter The father said the clinic staff did not answer his question and allegedly told him not to ask further. title: Pattaya nightclub dispute ends in gunfire, two hurt
desc: Pattaya nightclub dispute ends in gunfire, two hurt Legacy Two men were wounded in a shooting outside a nightclub in South Pattaya earlier today, August 31, following what police said was a dispute that began inside the venue. Pattaya City Police received a report of the shooting at 2.36am on August 31 near an entertainment venue in South Pattaya. Officers, Banglamung district officials and rescue volunteers from the Sawang Boriboon Thammasathan Foundation in Pattaya arrived to find a crowd gathered at the scene where two men had been wounded. One of the injured men, 29 year old Mongkol, reportedly a former volunteer with several official agencies, was shot in the right calf, with the bullet remaining lodged. Rescue workers treated him at the scene before he was taken to hospital. The second man, 36 year old Ratchaphon, known as “Ball,” suffered a gunshot wound to the left foot and facial swelling, and was also taken to hospital after first aid. Mongkol’s pickup truck had a bullet hole in the inner driver’s-side door. Police recovered a Glock 43 9mm pistol and ammunition as evidence. title: Thailand nominee crackdown cuts new filings by 75%
desc: Thailand nominee crackdown cuts new filings by 75% Legacy Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has clarified that a widely cited 75% drop in nominee businesses refers only to newly registered entities in the nominee-risk category , not to all nominee arrangements in Thailand. Suphajee raised the issue on Facebook as part of the ministry’s “Q&A with the Ministry of Commerce” series, responding to a question that followed the ministry’s 90-day performance briefing. She said the ministry recorded 141 newly registered high-risk entities between August 1 and 20, compared with 561 during the same period last year, a decline of 420 entities, or close to 75%. Suphajee said the ministry was acting on two fronts. Before registration, it had tightened checks on shareholders and those controlling businesses, cross-referencing data on about 13 million State Welfare Card holders and approximately 98,000 suspected mule accounts against one million juristic-person records. desc: Phuket drug investigation expands after teenage arrests Legacy The arrest of three teenage drug offenders led to another drug suspect and the seizure of more than five kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine yesterday, August 30. Border Patrol Police arrested three suspects aged between 17 and 19 with approximately 2.68 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine and 131.9 grammes of ketamine. Officers also seized drug paraphernalia, a digital scale and four mobile phones. Police accused the three of jointly possessing methamphetamine for sale, possessing ketamine without permission and using drugs.
